issues.explanation: Chapter 60 places the 涪城 meeting with 刘璋 and 庞统、法正 urging an attack before saying 刘备 finally decides to march west and then has 孟达迎接 him. In the source, 刘备 first marches into 西川 and meets 刘璋; only afterward do 庞统、法正 urge the banquet assassination, which continues in Chapter 61. This makes Chapter 61's banquet scene occur after an apparently completed decision and departure.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the initial decision to enter 西川 and the march before the 涪城 meeting. End Chapter 60 after 刘备拒绝在宴席杀刘璋 while 法正、庞统 continue urging him, or otherwise make clear that the later banquet plot is a new, post-arrival event rather than the cause of the march.
